Care Instructions for Chikankari Sarees & Suits
  • To maintain the beauty and longevity of your handcrafted Chikankari sarees and suits, please follow these care guidelines:
  • Do not wash roughly – Gentle handling is required to preserve delicate embroidery.
  • Do not soak – Avoid prolonged soaking to prevent color bleeding and fabric damage.
  • Do not iron directly on embellishments – Place a soft cloth over the embroidery before ironing or use a low-heat setting.
  • Dry clean only – Professional dry cleaning is recommended for best results and fabric care.
  • By following these instructions, you can ensure that your Chikankari sarees and suits remain elegant and long-lasting.
